name: American Eagle Outfitters
plan: NO POSITION. Price gate: alert below $14 (~8x FY26). Re-open only when Aerie AND the American Eagle namesake brand both show positive y/y segment revenue after the Q2 lap prints. Attention-name caution applies: this is not UNDISCOVERED.
catalyst: Q2 FY26 print 2026-09-02 (verified) - the direct anniversary of the viral quarter. 62.7% IV implies ~+/-9% for the day; realistic range +/-12-15%.
kill_triggers: American Eagle namesake brand comps negative for two consecutive quarters
edge_explainer: The queue asked what the -38% is measured against; tape-verified, it is measured against a peak sitting on top of a +203% run. Bars: 3y low $9.31 on 2025-06-13; +23.6% on 2025-08-04 as the Sydney Sweeney campaign went viral; +38.0% on 2025-09-04 on a genuine Q2 FY25 earnings blowout; +15.1% on 2025-12-03; peak $28.19 on 2026-01-06; then -8.4%/-13.9% in March and -11.8% on 2026-05-29 ('record first-quarter revenue, but the stock sinks'). AEO is still +53% y/y and +92% above its June-2025 low. This is attention decay and mean reversion, not the de-rating of a compounder - and at 10.5x FY26 it sits INSIDE its own historical 10-14x band, so the own-history-discount premise fails outright. The near-quarter estimate has been cut 48% ($0.3975 -> $0.2067 over 90 days, 3 down / 0 up in 7 days, -54% y/y) because it laps the viral quarter - but stated fairly, FY26 was NOT cut (-0.6%); analysts moved earnings into Q3 (+19.4%), a timing/mix reallocation rather than a collapse. So this is not a clean derailment either: a business doing fine, a brutal optical comp in the quarter that prints next, and a price that already reflects the good news. There is no takeaway-vs-data divergence - the Q1 release said record revenue and it was record revenue - so per the honesty-alpha doctrine this is CLEAN with no edge for us. Conditioning check fails independently: repeated 'trending stock' coverage, options-activity headlines, 17.6M shares short at 3.59 days to cover and 62.7% IV on a mall retailer.
top_unverifiable: No Aerie-vs-American-Eagle segment split. Whether the namesake brand is shrinking while Aerie masks it is the single most decision-relevant number in the name and it was not read - it sits under both the bear case and the segment-flooring risk. Secondarily, only 3 analysts cover the near-quarter, so the -48% cut is a thin-consensus datum.
screen_defect: '% off own 3y high' must be conditioned on the trailing 3y RETURN. Proposed: reject drawdown candidates whose trailing-3y total return is positive AND whose peak was set within 12 months of a >100% run. This would have removed both AEO and GLW from this cohort.
